content.text:
Implemented separate PDF text ingestion at `POST /api/ingest/pdf`. It extracts text with 1-based page references, enforces 10 MB and 250-page limits, and leaves the existing JSON audit flow unchanged. Extracted text and credentials are not sent to Neatlogs. PDF-to-record mapping still requires review; scanned PDFs have no OCR support.

**Verification:** typecheck passed; lint passed; all 8 tests passed. The test suite covers existing JSON audit behavior and PDF upload validation.

- `README.md`
- `package.json`
- `package-lock.json`
- `src/app/api/ingest/pdf/route.ts`
- `src/lib/pdf-ingestion.ts`
- `tests/pdf-ingestion.test.ts`

`.codex/hooks.json` was already modified before this work and was left untouched. Nothing was committed or pushed.
